Flamboyant gnome with a rat-tail beard and pinstripe vest. Always impeccably dressed.

What We Know

Guildmaster of the Exterminators Guild in Highreach. Runs the city's premier pest control operation. Known for his business acumen and connections throughout the city.

Charming and confident, with an air of authority that seems outsized for his stature.
